# Start here features DevIndex and ends on Dock Choreography

## Context

The operator, 19 Nov, on Start here at 1440×900 ([frame](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neomjs/neo/54e0075f2435e29431116725ac5a7daa19dcbfdf/review-evidence/21509/after-1440x900.png)): Workstation "makes sense as top 1"; Dashboard & Docking does not belong in the top six, "we can keep it in there, but as the last item"; and the card he misses is "the DevIndex app. One of our most stunning neo apps we ever built."

## The Problem

At `dev` `19058bf0ab`:

- Start here shows the `featured: true` records in catalog order, the twelve `#21140` set on 18 Nov: Workstation · 100,000 × 200 grid · tree grid at scale · **Dock Choreography** (4th) · COVID multi-window · GitHub Issues Grid · Studio Bookings · Community Garden Plan · Sprint Board · Calendar · Web Desktop · Country Statistics Grid.
- `devindex` has a card on the Apps page and `featured: false`.
- Its cover `devmode/DevIndex.png` is a full-app frame, 3872 × 2310 px and 1,758,427 bytes. Engine 14 covers are 1280 × 720 JPEGs under 150 KB (`buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs`, `MAX_BYTES`); the twelve featured covers weigh 42 to 423 KB. The first six cards load their images up front (`apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs:207`), so DevIndex in the top six at today's cover adds 1.7 MB to the page's first load.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/view/examples/Overview.mjs:139` filters the catalog by `featured` and `Example.publishes()` and sorts nothing: record order is card order, and the group pages use the same order.
- `resources/css/src/apps/portal/examples/List.css:15`: from 1100 px the list has three columns and the lead card spans two by two, so twelve cards fill five rows (lead and two, then nine); in two columns, six rows. A thirteenth card stands alone in a last row.
- `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs:900` pins `catalog.slice(0, 12)` and the featured filter to `startHereIds`.
- `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` captures a 640 × 360 CSS region at device pixel ratio 2 (`:24`, `:265`). On DevIndex that is six columns of five rows; the full-app frame holds the whole ranking. A record with an absolute devmode URL needs no recipe (`:160`).

Design authority: `#21140`, "Start here, in order: Workstation, the lead card … Country Statistics Grid" and "the twelve featured demonstrations as cards". This ticket revises the order on the operator's word above and keeps the twelve.

## The Fix

1. `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`, first twelve records: `workstation` · `grid-big-data` · `grid-tree-big-data` · **`devindex`** (`featured: true`) · `shared-covid` · `grid-issues` · `scheduler-basic` · `gantt-basic` · `board-basic` · `calendar` · `webdesktop` · **`dock-choreography`**. `grid-countries` turns `featured: false` and stands 13th, so its place on Grid & Table does not change and Dock Choreography still leads its own page.
2. DevIndex cover `devmode/devindex-14.jpg`: the `DevIndex.png` frame cropped to 16:9 from the top and scaled to 1280 × 720, under 150 KB, on `neomjs/pages` `main` before this merges (neomjs/pages#140); the record's `image` names it. The operator compared a recipe crop of the deployed app with this frame on 19 Nov: the frame is "way richer".
3. The spec's `startHereIds` and the lists after it follow; `seo.json` is regenerated.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Start here at 1440×900 and 1024×768 reads Workstation, the 100,000 × 200 grid, the tree grid at scale, DevIndex, the COVID app, GitHub Issues, Studio Bookings, the Garden Plan, Sprint Board, Calendar, Web Desktop, Dock Choreography: twelve cards, no orphan row.
- [ ] Country Statistics Grid keeps its card and its place on Grid & Table; Dock Choreography keeps its place on Dashboard & Docking.
- [ ] The DevIndex card shows `devindex-14.jpg` (1280 × 720, under 150 KB, the full-app frame) from Pages `main`.
- [ ] The portal unit specs and `verify.mjs` pass.

## Out of Scope

The DevIndex record's name and captions; Start here's layout; the other cards' covers; a capture recipe for DevIndex.

## Avoided Traps

- **A thirteenth card.** It breaks the grid the twelve were chosen for.
- **Moving `dock-choreography` to the end of the catalog.** It would also fall to the last place on its own group page.
- **Featuring the 1.7 MB PNG.** It triples what the first six cards cost to load.
- **A 640 × 360 recipe crop.** Six columns of five rows lose what makes the app worth featuring.
